# 33_trigger_parse_manuscript.sh - Start the manuscript conversion

<!-- BEGIN pipeline-callers: generated by tools/automation_doc_links.py, do not edit by hand -->
:::{attention} Usually run by a Bitbucket pipeline
`33_trigger_parse_manuscript.sh` is normally not run on its own. The Bitbucket pipelines listed below call it as one step of a longer job, after earlier steps have prepared its inputs and environment. Run it by hand mainly for debugging or local testing.

- [`w-big-populate-from-icpsr`](#pipeline-w-big-populate-from-icpsr), step "Download and commit": [line 522](https://github.com/AEADataEditor/replication-template/blob/master/bitbucket-pipelines.yml#L522)

## Description

Starts the `m-parse-manuscript` pipeline for the current Jira ticket with [bitbucket_trigger_pipeline.py](#help-bitbucket_trigger_pipeline). The ingest pipelines call it right after their "started" comment, so the conversion runs while the ingest runs.

The pipeline is only started when it is needed. The script downloads the PDF attachments into a scratch directory and compares the manuscript(s) with the checksums in `generated/manuscript.sha256`, which `31_parse_manuscript.sh` records after each successful conversion:

| Checksum file | Manuscript | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Missing or empty | Present | Started |
| Differs (changed, renamed, added or removed) | Present | Started |
| Same | Present | Not started |
| Any | None attached | Not started |

Other PDFs, such as forms, do not count. If the check itself fails, or there is no Jira ticket to check, the pipeline is started anyway.

It never fails. The ingest does not depend on the conversion, so a pipeline that could not be started is only reported as a warning. (The `atlassian/trigger-pipeline` pipe that hands over to the big ingest cannot be made optional this way: a failing pipe stops the step.)

## Usage

```bash
. ./tools/resolve_jiraticket.sh
./automations/33_trigger_parse_manuscript.sh
```

### Environment Variables

- `jiraticket` - Passed on to the pipeline; set by `tools/resolve_jiraticket.sh`.
- `JIRA_USERNAME`, `JIRA_API_KEY` - Credentials for the attachment download.
- `JIRA_USERNAME`, `P_BITBUCKET_PAT` - Credentials for the Bitbucket API.
- `BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE`, `BITBUCKET_REPO_SLUG`, `BITBUCKET_BRANCH` - Set by Bitbucket Pipelines.
